title: Acyclicity of the ripple-carry adder gates
statement: For every natural number $n$, the list of gates obtained by starting with the two constant gates, appending $n/3$ successive bit blocks with parameters prescribed by the ripple-carry construction, and then appending its two final gates is acyclic: each input index read by the gate at position $i$ is less than $n+i$.
hypotheses_covered: the gate list is the specified adder construction with $k=n/3$ and $n/3$ bit blocks
caveat: The construction is encoded through several upstream list-generating definitions whose informal descriptions are stubs, so the exact gate wiring is not fully specified in the available prose.
